ideas.pitch: An AI-powered satellite monitoring and industrial land compliance platform tailored for local environmental regulations in India, leveraging computer vision to track illegal dumping and emissions.
ideas.title: EcoCompliance-ATLAS
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the exact pattern of GeoNex-ATLAS by solving real-world regional industrial compliance challenges using satellite data, which heavily appeals to local state-level judges and governance bodies.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered patient and trust acquisition engine optimized for rural healthcare and localized prosthodontic/dental clinics across Indian states, bridging trust deficits with multi-lingual voice agents.
ideas.title: AgriTrust-AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adapts the winning formula of Global-Smile for local Indian healthcare contexts where linguistic diversity and trust engines are massive priorities for regional adoption.

ideas.pitch: An AWS-powered AML risk detection and transaction investigation platform combining graph intelligence and light gradient boosting to flag fraudulent UPI and banking rings in real time.
ideas.title: FinGuard-AML
ideas.why_it_could_win: Employs genuinely hard financial engineering and graph intelligence similar to Bito, capturing judges' attention through high technical difficulty and financial security relevance.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered regional nutrition and wellness platform that delivers personalized meal recommendations based on traditional Indian thalis, local dietary habits, and caloric health goals.
ideas.title: NutriBharat
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the winning structure of E-Foodiee-AI-Nutrition-Assistant while hyper-localizing the dataset for Indian cultural food habits, making the demo instantly relatable to judges.

ideas.pitch: A multi-agent student support and campus sustainability platform combining LangGraph, RAG, and personalized AI agents to optimize energy use and student queries in Indian university hostels.
ideas.title: CampusGreen-Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the multi-agent architecture of the greennovation-ai-platform, hitting both sustainability and campus utility metrics which resonate well with collegiate hackathon judges.
